Getting data back takes two steps. 1. Request: the archive copies the dataset from tape to the retrieve server. That can take hours, and SciCat emails you when it is done.
2. Copy: a dataset that is "Ready to copy" can be copied to a folder on this computer.
None of the selected datasets is ready to copy yet. Request them first: a dataset can be copied once its state is "Ready to copy".
